description: This file defines a test utility class 'OrderBuilder' used for constructing 'Order' objects with default or customized test data in unit tests for the eShopOnWeb application.

classes.name: OrderBuilder
classes.description: A builder class to facilitate creation of 'Order' instances with default or specific values for testing purposes.

methods.name: OrderBuilder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the builder with default order values.

methods.name: WithDefaultValues
methods.description: Builds an 'Order' with default test data including one order item.

methods.name: WithNoItems
methods.description: Builds an 'Order' with no order items.

methods.name: WithItems
methods.description: Builds an 'Order' with a provided list of order items.
